addressed.claim_id: payload now includes reference as 4-tuple (account, currency, amount, reference) stored in seen and compared for duplicate vs conflict per Rule 7/8
key/account validation changed from strip() check to literal non-empty string (key == "" / account == "") per Rule 4 spec definition

Fixed amount validation to reject strings with more than 2 fractional digits (e.g. "10.000", "1.234", "10.100") by inspecting Decimal exponent (as_tuple().exponent < -2) instead of numeric equality after quantize, which incorrectly accepted them due to Decimal equality ignoring trailing zeros.
